channel_intelligence.state_of_channel: Day 49. 12 subscribers (+1), 78 public videos (+17), 4,567 lifetime views (3,829 -> 4,567, +19%). Studio 28-day: 4,002 views (+6.2%), 131.2 watch hours (+4.4%), 18,532 impressions (+23.8%) at 2.3% CTR (down from 2.8%). The single most important thing this week: the CTR drop is not a thumbnail problem, it is a search problem. YouTube served 7,960 search impressions this period, up 74% from 4,586, and converted 0.8% of them into 198 views. Search is now 43% of every impression the channel receives and returns 4.9% of views and 5.2% of watch time. Meanwhile SUGGESTED VIDEOS again carried 77.3% of all watch time (101.4 of 131.2 hours) from 10.6% of views at 14:21 AVD and 3.4% CTR. Worse for the search thesis: 'bossa nova', last week's best query, has fallen out of the top query list entirely, replaced by 'cozy asmr' (5 views), and for the second straight week not one Study/Focus/Work/Sleep term appears. A new style launched Aug 3 - Soft Jazz Guitar, 1:50:25 - and posted the best first week of any long the channel has released (20 views, 5.1 watch hours) on a below-average 2.3% CTR. Pinterest analytics rendered for the first time in five weeks and reported zero: no impressions, no clicks, no saves, 'Not enough data to display'.
what_works: SUGGESTED VIDEOS IS STILL THE ENTIRE BUSINESS: 425 views (10.6%) produced 101.4 watch hours (77.3% of the channel) at 14:21 AVD and 3.4% CTR. Search produced 7,960 impressions, 0.8% CTR, 198 views, 6.8 hours. Second consecutive week the split has held at roughly this ratio, so this is now an established fact about the channel, not a one-week reading.

FUN BOSSA LONGS BEAT SOFT BOSSA ON WATCH TIME, CONFIRMED AT n=3: Fun longs average 13.67 watch hours per video at 4.61% impression-weighted CTR; Soft longs average 7.36 hours at 3.49%. That is 1.86x - down from last week's 2.3x now that the third Fun long is in the sample, but the direction survived adding a weak data point, which is the test that matters. 'Happy Bossa Nova Lounge' is the channel's #1 watch-time video for the second week (30.1 hrs, 23% of everything, from 82 views). Runtime is still a confound: all Fun longs run 1:39:06 vs Soft's 1:17:43.

'A MINUTE OF CALM FOR YOUR DAY' IS THE BEST-PROVEN ASSET ON THE REEL SIDE: n=5, avg 187.8 views, max 277 of 939 total - no outlier propping it up - and it holds three of the four highest reel retention scores on the channel (30.9%, 34.1%, 18.2%). It overtook 'Bossa nova + coffee = perfect morning', which shows a higher raw average (197.9) only because 1,034 of its 1,385 views are one Jul 24 post; strip that and it averages 58.5 across the other six and ranks fourth.

THE NOON SLOT EDGE WIDENED AND IS NOW THE CLEANEST FINDING IN THE REPORT: 16:00Z averages 112.3 views across 26 reels versus 40.7 across 24 at 22:00Z. Excluding the 1,034 outlier it is still 75.5 vs 40.7 - a 1.85x gap, up from 1.5x last week, on the largest sample in this analysis. By day, honest ranking (outlier removed) is Sat 108.0 > Thu 99.4 > Sun 62.4 > Mon 52.5 > Tue 37.0 > Wed 23.3 > Fri 20.6.

PLAYLISTS REMAIN THE BEST-CONVERTING SURFACE: 7.1% CTR and 12:54 AVD, roughly double suggested-video CTR - but on only 225 impressions and 24 views. Same thin sample as last week, and the reason it is thin is that the playlists still have not been built. This is a hypothesis that has now sat untested for two weeks.
next_moves: REPACKAGE THE SOFT JAZZ GUITAR LONG AND KEEP THE STYLE. The music is the best-validated new thing on the channel: 20 views and 5.1 watch hours in seven days, versus 5 views for the previous new long's first week. But its 2.3% CTR is below every Fun Bossa long. Rebuild the thumbnail in the Fun Bossa visual family (the one pulling 4.6-5.1%) and re-measure next week. Highest-leverage single action available.

STOP TITLING LONGS FOR SEARCH - THIS IS NOW A TWO-WEEK VERDICT. Search impressions grew 74% and CTR fell to 0.8%; zero study/focus/work/sleep queries appeared for the second consecutive week; and the one term that was working, 'bossa nova', dropped off the list. Titles and thumbnails should be built to look like the natural next video in a suggested-video session - same mood family, same visual world as 'Happy Bossa Nova Lounge' - not stuffed with 'Study Music for Focus & Concentration'. Apply to the next two longs and compare CTR.

BUILD THE PLAYLISTS. Flagged last week, not done. 7.1% CTR and 12:54 AVD on 225 impressions is the highest-converting surface the channel has and it is starved purely because the playlists do not exist. Group the 14 longs into three themed playlists (Morning Cafe, Deep Focus, Sleep/Evening) and add every long to one. One hour of work, and it directly feeds the suggested-video engine that produces 77% of watch time.

CUT THE TWO THINGS ALREADY FLAGGED AND NOT ACTIONED. (1) Retire 'Soft jazz to ease into the day' from the caption bank - it posted twice more this week and is now n=7 at avg 19.9, a 9x gap to the top caption. (2) Rebuild the 'Cozy Coffee Shop Bossa Nova' thumbnail - it still holds the most impressions on the channel (2,030) at the worst major CTR (2.9%); moving it to 3.9% is worth roughly 20 extra views a month from work already done.

AUDIT PINTEREST ONCE, THEN DECIDE. The dashboard now confirms zero impressions, zero clicks, zero saves over 30 days, and YouTube's External source shows 5 views in 28 days. Spend 20 minutes checking whether any pins actually exist on the account - the known auto-pin blocker (save-from-URL rejects 16:9, needs 2:3-1:1) may mean nothing has ever been posted. If the board is empty, fix the aspect ratio or drop the channel. Do not keep budgeting time for a surface that has never registered a single impression.

LOG THE THUMBNAIL FONT - THIRD TIME ASKING. make_thumbnail.py randomizes the font family and discards the choice. Writing it into adm-upload-state.json at render time is a five-line change that unlocks an entire analysis dimension currently returning 'unavailable' every week.

channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules: (1) always 'instrumental / no vocals' - this is background music; (2) keep energy CONSISTENT with no dynamic spikes - suggested-video sessions run 14:21 average and listeners leave when a track jumps; (3) WRITE LONG SETS - the channel's #1 watch-time video runs 1:39:06 and banks 30.1 hours from 82 views, and the new Soft Jazz Guitar long at 1:50:25 posted the best first week the channel has had; target 100-110 minutes of continuous material, not 77; (4) FUN/UPBEAT BOSSA OVER SOFT/SLEEPY for longs - confirmed at n=3, Fun delivers 1.86x the watch hours per video (13.67 vs 7.36) and higher impression-weighted CTR (4.61% vs 3.49%); the multiple shrank from 2.3x when a third video was added, so treat 1.5-2x as the honest range; (5) SOFT JAZZ GUITAR IS A LIVE SECOND BET - one long, 5.1 watch hours and 20 views in week one, the strongest launch the channel has had; keep producing it and judge again in two weeks; (6) name 2-3 concrete instruments, not just a genre; (7) DO NOT ENGINEER LONGS AROUND SEARCH KEYWORDS - two consecutive weeks of evidence: search served 7,960 impressions at 0.8% CTR, zero study/focus/work/sleep queries appeared, and 'bossa nova' fell off the query list entirely while 77.3% of watch time came from suggested videos. Write and package music that belongs in the same session as what is already being recommended: same mood family, same tempo range, same cafe world; (8) reels and longs stay on separate title systems - longs get mood/session language, reels get casual feeling captions; (9) the winning reel caption is 'A minute of calm for your day' (n=5, avg 187.8, no outlier, and three of the channel's four best retention scores). Captions that address the VIEWER'S day or name a concrete sensory pair beat captions that describe the music - 'Soft jazz to ease into the day' is n=7 at avg 19.9 and should be retired.

deep_analytics.key_read: Two weeks of consistent evidence. Suggested videos is where the channel lives: 10.6% of views produce 77.3% of watch time at 14:21 AVD. Search is actively getting worse - impressions up 74% to 7,960, CTR down to 0.8%, 'bossa nova' gone from the query list, and zero study/focus/work/sleep terms for the second week running. The channel-wide CTR fall from 2.8% to 2.3% is a search-impression denominator effect, not a thumbnail regression; per-long CTRs are flat or up. Reels supply 79.7% of views and 1.7% of watch time - a reach and subscriber-funnel instrument only. Longs, especially Fun Bossa near 100 minutes and now Soft Jazz Guitar at 110 minutes, are the entire watch-time business.
deep_analytics.method_note: Captured by coordinate-clicking 'Advanced mode' in Studio (top-right, ~966,76 at 1400px width), then Breakdown dropdown -> Traffic source, then clicking the YouTube search row to drill into query terms. Column headers re-sort the table. Chrome's javascript_tool blocks any returned string containing & = or ? and truncates near 1,200 characters - strip those characters and chunk output.

social_intelligence.state_of_socials: Followers: TikTok 40 (+8, from 32), Instagram 32 (+5, from 27), YouTube 12 (+1). TikTok retook the growth lead after Instagram's outlier +200% week did not repeat - both are still compounding, but the weekly growth rate roughly halved. Cadence is unchanged and clean: 42 posts in the trailing 7 days (14 each on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts), all reporting status=published, zero failures, 166 posts tracked in Zernio total. The SSD clip queue sits at 102 for the third straight week - nightly batch output and posting cadence are exactly in balance, so no supply risk and no headroom. The single most important thing: the noon slot advantage has WIDENED and is now the best-evidenced finding on the social side - 16:00Z averages 112.3 views across 26 reels versus 40.7 across 24 at 22:00Z, and even after removing the 1,034-view Jul 24 outlier it is 75.5 vs 40.7, a 1.85x gap up from 1.5x last week. The hard truth attached: YouTube's External traffic source recorded 5 views in 28 days, and Pinterest analytics - which rendered for the first time in five weeks - reports zero impressions, zero outbound clicks and zero saves over 30 days. The social accounts are building their own audiences and feeding the Shorts feed; the off-platform path to the YouTube channel is delivering essentially nothing.
whats_out: 42 reels live in the last 7d across Instagram (14), TikTok (14), YouTube Shorts (14) - full 2x/day cadence at 12:00 and 18:00 ET, zero failed posts, flat versus last week

'A minute of calm for your day' is now the best-proven caption on the channel: n=5, avg 187.8 views, no outlier, and three of the four highest reel retention scores (30.9%, 34.1%, 18.2%)

PINTEREST ANSWERED AFTER FIVE WEEKS: the analytics dashboard rendered and reports 'Not enough data to display' - zero impressions, zero engagements, zero outbound clicks, zero saves for 7/11-8/10. Corroborated by YouTube External = 5 views / 28 days. Four weeks of 'unavailable' were hiding a zero.
suggestions: MOVE BOTH DAILY POSTS INTO THE NOON WINDOW, OR AT MINIMUM GIVE NOON THE STRONGER CAPTION. The 12:00 ET slot averages 112.3 views across 26 reels versus 40.7 across 24 at 18:00 - 2.76x raw, 1.85x with the outlier stripped, on the largest and cleanest sample in this analysis. The gap grew from 1.5x last week rather than regressing to the mean. This is the single highest-confidence change available on the social side.

RETIRE 'Soft jazz to ease into the day' - THIS WAS FLAGGED LAST WEEK AND IT POSTED TWICE MORE. It is now n=7 at avg 19.9 views, a 9x gap to 'A minute of calm for your day' (avg 187.8). Every slot it occupies is a slot the winning captions could have. Weight the batch toward 'A minute of calm for your day' and 'Slow morning, warm coffee, soft bossa nova' (n=3, avg 85.3), and treat the new 'Pour the coffee, press play' (n=1, 8 views) as unproven.

AUDIT THE PINTEREST ACCOUNT ONCE, THEN DECIDE - 20 MINUTES, NOT AN HOUR. Log in and check whether any pins actually exist. The known blocker is that save-from-URL rejects 16:9 and needs 2:3-1:1, so it is plausible nothing has ever successfully posted. If the boards are empty, either re-crop the visuals to 2:3 and use the organic upload flow, or drop Pinterest entirely. What is not defensible is continuing to budget time for a surface with zero impressions in 30 days.

SHIFT THE WEEKEND WEIGHTING. Honest day ranking with the outlier removed: Sat 108.0 > Thu 99.4 > Sun 62.4 > Mon 52.5 > Tue 37.0 > Wed 23.3 > Fri 20.6. Friday's headline 147.3 average is entirely the single Jul 24 breakout - without it Friday is the worst day of the week. Put the strongest captions on Thu/Sat/Sun and the weakest on Fri/Wed.

DO NOT RAISE CADENCE WITHOUT RAISING BATCH OUTPUT. The queue has been flat at 102 for three weeks, which means make_reels_batch.py is replacing exactly what gets posted. Any cadence increase drains the buffer, and the hard rule that every reel uses a unique image means the constraint is images, not tracks. Raise batch output first, then cadence.
